description: Framework for classifying content based on AI involvement and human accountability.

levels.name: Fully AI-Generated (Unreviewed)
levels.description: Content generated entirely by AI with no human validation.
levels.guidance: Not suitable for production or decision-making use.

levels.name: AI-Generated, Human-Reviewed
levels.description: AI-generated content that has been reviewed and validated by a human.
levels.guidance: Minimum acceptable level for most practical use cases.

levels.name: AI-Assisted, Human-Led
levels.description: Content primarily created by a human with AI providing support (drafting, suggestions, structuring).
levels.guidance: Default working model for most scenarios.

levels.name: Human-Created, AI-Enhanced
levels.description: Human-created content with minor AI assistance (e.g., grammar, formatting, optimisation).
levels.guidance: High confidence with minimal AI influence.

levels.name: Fully Human (No AI Involvement)
levels.description: Content created entirely without AI assistance.
levels.guidance: Used where strict control, compliance, or complete human authorship is required.

principles: AI involvement should be transparent where appropriate
Required level of oversight may vary based on risk and use case

aliases.name: AI-Assisted Reviewed
aliases.description: Officially supported alias of AIG-R representing the same classification level.

examples: Classification: AICCF: FH (Fully Human - No AI Involvement)

aia_r_review_workflow.name: AIA-R Review Workflow Clarification
aia_r_review_workflow.description: In some scenarios, AI generates content directly from author-defined requirements and follows the applicable structure, template, coding standards, or documentation standards. To improve workflow efficiency, such content may be created directly with an AIA-R (AI-Assisted Reviewed) classification while clearly indicating that author review is still required.

pending_review_notice.text: *Pending Author Review (Please remove this line after review)

pending_review_example: *Pending Author Review (Please remove this line after review)
notes: The author remains accountable for review and approval.
The "Pending Author Review" notice provides visibility that review has not yet been completed.
The notice should be removed once review is complete.
Testing, repository storage, validation, approval, and publication activities should occur after appropriate review.

example_disclaimers: This content was generated with AI assistance and reviewed by a human.
AI-generated output – requires validation before use.
Human-led work supported by AI tools.
This content was created entirely without AI assistance.

ai_generated_content_awaiting_review.description: AI generated content created from author-defined requirements, classified as AIA-R with a temporary Pending Author Review notice.
